prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP NIV, adult woman requiring ongoing care, proposes ash-brown shoulder-length hair, muted moss shawl and brown dress, seated upright on a modest backless stool, simple blanket across knees, one small plain house key held in her own hand; tired but alert, no invented wounds or bandages, no named diagnosis. MIDDLE BENO adult male ordinary care shift coordinator, broad middle-aged man, short dark beard, dull blue wool tunic with plain natural-linen apron, empty hands and closed small belt pouch; no physician badge. BOTTOM ENA, adult woman LAND-route reception coordinator at Coldwindow inn, grey-brown hood back, muted ochre short cape over dark green travel dress, simple boots and closed blank small schedule folio. This ENA is a DISTINCT original person, not the existing N2 winch-worker relative. No boat, port, migration performed, occupied bed proof or universal care guarantee.
